brand.name: flavouria
brand.personality: Modern, warm, premium, food-focused, trustworthy, simple, friendly, minimal, mobile-first
brand.logo_instructions: Lowercase wordmark 'flavouria'. Standalone icon combining subtle fork/bowl/leaf/warm-food elements. NO letter F.
brand.differentiator: Displays ONLY the Top 3 recipes per search. Core loop: SEARCH -> TOP 3 -> COMPARE -> CHOOSE -> COOK.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Maintain a warm, organic feel. Do not overuse all colors at once. Background should be warm cream/off-white. Text should be deep navy. Use coral for prominent CTAs. Yellow for ratings/stars. Green for dietary badges. Never use pure black (#000000).

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-tight text-primary
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure to import Nunito and Manrope fonts. Do not use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings. Keep headings tight and bold, body text clean and legible.

layouts.hero: A massive, centralized hero area. Headline 'What do you want to cook?' + supporting 'Get the 3 recipes worth your time.' A prominent, elevated search bar. Suggestion chips below. 'How it works' bento grid with 3 cards (01 Search, 02 Compare, 03 Cook).
layouts.search_results: Bento-style asymmetric grid or vertical stacked list displaying exactly 3 rich, massive premium recipe cards. Focus on comparison.
layouts.recipe_card: Highly rounded (`rounded-3xl`), white surface with soft shadow (`shadow-md`). Includes overlapping elegant rank badges (1st, 2nd, 3rd). Large high-quality image. Metadata tags (time, cuisine, spice, rating). Creator avatar. 'Why it's here' tag. CTAs: View Recipe & Watch Video.
layouts.recipe_detail: Immersive hero image (max 80vh height). Clean bento-box layout for ingredients, numbered method steps, and rating widget.
layouts.creator_dashboard: Clean, dense grid-based layout using Shadcn components (tables, charts, analytics widgets). Cardless or very subtle rounded cards with 1px borders.
layouts.general: Mobile-first. Use generative padding (`p-6`, `p-8`, `p-12`). Container should be constrained `max-w-7xl mx-auto`.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) or highly rounded (`rounded-2xl`). Soft hover lifts (`-translate-y-0.5`). Primary button uses coral accent (`bg-[#FF6B5E] text-white hover:bg-[#F05649]`).
components.badges: Pill shaped (`rounded-full`), subtle background tint (e.g., `bg-green-100 text-green-800` for time, `bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800` for ratings, `bg-orange-100 text-orange-800` for spice).
components.search_bar: Massive, highly visible. `h-16` or `h-20`. Left icon (search). Right side has the primary 'Search' button nested IN the input container. On focus, expand slightly with a subtle ring.

motion.hover_states: Cards lift `-translate-y-1` and shadow deepens. Buttons scale slightly `scale-105`. Interactive elements must have transitions.
motion.interactions: Search bar focus expansion, rating star selection micro-animation, heart/bookmark scaling bounce on save, rank badge subtle pulse.
motion.instructions_to_main_agent: Use `framer-motion` for page transitions (fade-in, slide-up). Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Exclude transforms from universal transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure coral text and white text on coral meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use pure transparent backgrounds over content.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="search-input"`, `data-testid="view-recipe-button"`).

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use these exact image URLs as placeholders. Do not use generic dummy image services.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Do not apply universal transitions (`transition: all`). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
Do not center-align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }` is strictly prohibited).
Ensure glass-morphism effects have actual blur and slight saturation boost.
Never use generic AI emojis like 🤖, 🧠 as icons. Use `lucide-react` icons exclusively.
Include hover states and micro-animations for all interactable elements.
Use generous spacing (`p-6` or `p-8` minimum inside containers).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds over content in headers or dropdowns.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React.js (.js, NOT .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI primitives, Framer Motion.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Since this is full-stack, design flows for Homepage, Search Results Top-3, Recipe Detail, Categories, Creator Dashboard, Auth.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Use Shadcn components for forms, inputs, selects, dropdowns, and dialogs. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for custom expressive layouts (like Top-3 cards). Use `sonner` for toasts.
